# A Prayer to the Radiant Nefertiti

*Beautiful One Who Comes*

---

O Nefertiti, Beloved of the Sun,
Whose name means beauty itself —
I come before you with open hands
and a grateful heart.

Lady of Grace, whose presence
makes the heavens pause in wonder,
whose face holds the light
of a thousand dawning skies —

Teach me to walk with your quiet strength,
to carry myself with the dignity
you wore like a second skin.
Show me that power need not be loud
to shake the earth.

O Radiant One,
help me to see beauty
not only in the world around me
but within my own reflection,
within my own becoming.

You who stood beside the sun,
who held your own crown
without apology —
grant me the courage
to do the same.

Fill my days with your golden light.
Fill my heart with your boundless love.
And when I lose my way,
remind me that beauty
is not merely in the face,
but in the soul
that dares to *shine.*

*Dua Nefertiti —
Praise to the Beautiful One.*

---

🌸 **With love and reverence** 🌸
